text:
The syntax error in `models/analytics_obt/obt_product_inventory.sql` is fixed, and the model now builds.

The file lives under `models/analytics_obt/`, not `models/`. The SELECT list in the `source` CTE was missing a comma after `p.supplier_company`, so the parser read `p.standard_cost` as a continuation of the previous expression and failed at the `.`. I added the comma. Nothing else in the file changed.

`dbt build --select obt_product_inventory+` now succeeds. The earlier full build showed the only failure was this model, with the other 28 nodes passing. I did not reconcile the model's row counts or totals against its sources, since the task was only the syntax error.
